Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console

Class PageCapture

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console.PageCapture
public final class PageCapture extends Object
Typed, per-render capture of one console page: theme, header, footer, nav tree, active nav, cards and slot templates, held as FreeMarker Environment custom state (see KEY) so every directive in the render shares one instance. <@console> serializes it as the #juneau-page contract.
Example:

// Inside a custom directive that contributes a card: public void execute(Environment env, Map params, TemplateModel[] loop, TemplateDirectiveBody body) throws TemplateException, IOException { PageCapture page = PageCapture.of(env); page.addCard(CardSpec.html("intro").title("Welcome"), PageCapture.render(body)); } // In a test, after rendering: String json = PageCapture.get(env).toContractJson();

Since:
10.0.0

  • Method Details

    • of

      public static PageCapture of(freemarker.core.Environment env) throws freemarker.template.TemplateModelException
      Returns the capture for this render, creating it on first use.

      On create, a PageSpec carried in the data model under PageSpec.ATTR is applied to the new capture before any directive writes to it, and marked adopted.

      Parameters:
      env - The FreeMarker environment.
      Returns:
      The capture, never null.
      Throws:
      freemarker.template.TemplateModelException - If seeding a PageSpec from the data model fails.

    • applyPendingNavAdds

      public void applyPendingNavAdds() throws freemarker.template.TemplateModelException
      Resolves every pending nav addition recorded by addPendingNavUnder(java.lang.String, org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console.PageCapture.NavAdder), in declaration order. The pending list is cleared first, so a second call does nothing.
      Throws:
      freemarker.template.TemplateModelException - If a parentIdPath does not match an existing node.

    • mergeBodyAttrs

      public PageCapture mergeBodyAttrs(String attrs) throws freemarker.template.TemplateModelException
      Merge-aware setter for the raw <@body> attribute text: union by attribute name, existing (spec) text first and then the new text. The same attribute name on both sides is always rejected, even when the values agree. Called once, from checkConsoleClose(), with the text <@body> captured into ftlBodyAttrs.
      Parameters:
      attrs - The raw <@body> attribute text. Blank is a no-op.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      freemarker.template.TemplateModelException - If an attribute name already set is set again.
